rationale: This empirical socio-legal study examines internal factory regulations, migrant workers' legitimacy judgments and the emergence of labour law in private and subcontracting workplaces in China. It does not address water or sanitation service access (C1 = no) or any water/sanitation access outcome (C4 = no), warranting exclusion under E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although the article examines legal and normative workplace rules (labour law emergence and internal factory regulations), it has no connection to household or community water or sanitation services and is excluded for wrong topic (E01) under both the narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2.

evidence_quotes.quote: analyser l'émergence d'un droit du travail dans les nouvelles formes d'entreprise qui se développent aujourd'hui en Chine
Les données recueillies concernent des usines privées chinoises, des usines chinoises travaillant en sous-traitance pour des entreprises étrangères
